english: Side effects, adverse events and serious adverse events, and why they are reported.
Possible side effects — watch children after AZM and refer any child who becomes unwell.
Drug safety means monitoring and managing the risks of medicines, so the benefits outweigh any harm.
Minor, expected reactions to medicines that do not require stopping treatment.
Any untoward medical occurrence at any dose resulting in death, hospitalization or longer hospitalization, persistent or significant disability or incapacity, or congenital anomaly or birth defect.
Serious adverse events must be reported immediately.
Pharmacovigilance aims at rational and safe use of medicines.
It assesses and communicates the risks and benefits of medicines, to improve patient care and public health.
No drug is always safe for everyone.
